frozen_market.question: Will the Democratic Party win the CA-01 House seat?
frozen_market.literal_rule: Yes iff candidate winning CA-01 U.S. House seat in 2026 midterms (Nov 3) is Democratic. Party is ballot-listed/otherwise identifiable when all 2026 House races are conclusively called by resolution sources. If no D/R ballot-listed affiliation, use most recently expressed caucus intent then. Consensus of credible reporting; if ambiguous, official U.S. government results (FEC).

primary_source_facts.publication_or_event_date: June 2, 2026 primary; official SOS Statement of Vote PDF
primary_source_facts.fact: SOS U.S. Representative results table labels 1st Congressional District: Mike McGuire (DEM) 92,121 (41.8%); James Gallagher (REP) 92,975 (42.1%); also Audrey Denney (DEM), Janice Karrman (DEM), Timothy Sean Kelly (NPP), Richard T. Minner (NPP). June primary data, not November winner.

primary_source_facts.publication_or_event_date: June 2, 2026 special primary; SOS official canvass page
primary_source_facts.fact: SOS page labels a separate Congressional District 1 special primary: James Gallagher (REP) 123,551 (62.1%), Audrey Denney (DEM) 36,841 (18.5%), Mike McGuire (DEM) 34,319 (17.3%), others. Page says no special general because one candidate exceeded 50%; footnote attributes vacancy to Doug LaMalfa’s death and lists included counties. This is the special race, distinct from regular November election.

SOS: voter-nominated candidates share ballot; voters may choose regardless of party; top two advance to Nov 3, 2026 general regardless of totals; general required even with only one or two primary candidates.
